subject: CareBridge activation sequencing & owner playbook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@carebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CareBridge deal closed — quick handoff notes and ask

Team —

Thanks for the quick sprint here. CareBridge (contact: Lena Ortiz) executed the SOW this morning and expects a soft go-live window in early July. High-level details below so CS can kick off planning: 

- ARR / scope: $420k annual, hosted inference for clinical summarization + embeddings (search).
- Deployment: VPC-connected hosted deployment in us-west-2; customer requires SOC2 evidence and HIPAA BAA prior to production.
- Target acceptance: 2027-07-09 (customer requested, flexible by ~1 week).
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state 20–30 reqs/sec with 300 token average per gen, burst to 150 reqs/sec during peak hours.
- Model notes: we'll be serving a fine-tuned 13B open model; runtime will use quantized path (Q4) — engineering flagged GPU memory planning required.

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (draft timeline & responsibilities), SOW-draft-v1.pdf (signed copy attached by legal).

Immediate asks for CS team: 
1) Confirm primary CS owner and secondary technical lead.
2) Propose kickoff meeting date (30–45m) in the next 4 business days.
3) Call out any blockers re: SOC2/BAA or infra that need sales to close.

Irene — looping you as escalation contact. Monica / Karthik — appreciate a quick note with owners and first-steps.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
(415) 555-0134

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge deal closed — quick handoff notes and ask

Thanks Aditya — good summary.

Proposed owner playbook below (happy to adjust):
- Primary CS Owner: Monica Patel — overall program owner and customer success lead.
- Technical Lead (post-sign): Karthik Iyer — responsible for deployment runbook, infra validation, and go/no-go checklist.
- Escalation / Account Sponsor: Irene Choi — exec escalations, SLA exceptions, and approvals.

Suggested kickoff: Thu 2027-06-10 10:00 AM PT (30m). Monica, can you confirm?

Pre-kickoff checklist (to share in the meeting):
- Sales to provide: network contact for VPC peering, legal contact for BAA, signed SOW (Aditya attached draft; request final signed PDF).
- CS to prepare: deployment-runbook-template.md (attached), proposed rollout timeline, acceptance criteria.
- Security: ask for SOC2 auditor point of contact and any restricted-data examples.

Meeting agenda (10m intro / scope, 10m security & infra, 5m timeline, 5m next steps & owners).

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CB-2027-0421) and onboarding GDrive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-carebridge-onboarding).

- Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Success Operations
irene_choi@redwood.com

Subject: Re: CareBridge deal closed — quick handoff notes and ask

Irene / team — happy to take primary ownership. Confirming the kickoff on Thu 2027-06-10 10:00 AM PT works for me.

I added a few notes after reviewing the MAP and the environment ask: 
- Timeline change: we should build two-week staging window before acceptance (so soft go-live target of 2027-07-09 becomes acceptance target 2027-07-23). I'll present the rationale in kickoff.
- Security ask: please ask CareBridge to share SOC2 type II report and a named auditor contact. Also need a signed BAA (we'll send our standard BAA template).
- Infra asks for sales to provide before we start infra validation: 
  * Network contact + CIDR ranges for VPC peering.
  * Sample payloads/data schema for search embedding index (redacted).
  * Expected retention policy for logs and KV cache.

Quick RACI (draft):
- Sales (Aditya) — customer liaison, contract questions, help collect legal docs (Due: 6/11).
- CS (Monica) — program owner, acceptance criteria, staging plan (Due: 6/14).
- Engineering (Karthik) — deploy runbook, infra validation, capacity tuning (Due: 6/16).

Attachments: deployment-runbook-template.md (attached).

I will coordinate a short pre-kickoff run (internal 15m) Wed 6/9 3:00 PM PT to align owners — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
